extracted.name: Vegetable soup
extracted.description: Try a basic vegetable soup recipe that can be adapted for whatever veg you've got in the fridge. Serve with creme fraiche and fresh herbs
ingredient_lines: 200g chopped vegetables such as onions, celery and carrots
crème fraîche and fresh herbs, to serve
instruction_lines: Fry the vegetables and potatoes in a pan with the oil for a few minutes until beginning to soften.
Cover with the stock and simmer for 10-15 mins until the veg is tender. Blend until smooth, then season. Serve with a dollop of crème fraîche and some fresh herbs. Will freeze for up to one month.
